predictions.quote: I think to me quantum feels like where AI was around you know 2015. So I would say in a 5-year time frame you would have that moment where some a really useful practical computation you know is done in a quantum way far superior to classical computers and that'll be that aha moment.
predictions.prediction: Within about 5 years, quantum computing will achieve a genuinely useful practical computation that is far superior to what classical computers can do.

predictions.quote: So I think you know we are probably two to three years away from that magical moment in robotics too and so so that's the next exciting phase.
predictions.prediction: Robotics (humanoid/physical AI) will reach a breakthrough 'magical moment' within two to three years.
